}

import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier
d = pd.read_csv("deliveries.csv", parse_dates=["created"])
ok = d[d["actual_min"].between(1, 299)].copy()
ok["hour"] = ok["created"].dt.hour
cols = ["distance_km", "items", "promised_min", "hour"]
y = ok["actual_min"] > ok["promised_min"]
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(ok[cols], y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42)
y_test = ~y_test
test_by_leaf = {}
for k in [1, 5, 20, 50, 100]:
    model = DecisionTreeClassifier(min_samples_leaf=k, random_state=0).fit(X_train, y_train)
    test_by_leaf[k] = round(model.score(X_test, y_test), 3)
best_leaf = max(test_by_leaf, key=test_by_leaf.get)

import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeRegressor
from sklearn.metrics import mean_absolute_error

d = pd.read_csv("deliveries.csv", parse_dates=["created"])
ok = d[d["actual_min"].between(1, 299)].copy()
ok["hour"] = ok["created"].dt.hour
y = ok["actual_min"]
X = pd.get_dummies(ok[["distance_km", "items", "promised_min", "hour", "courier", "weather", "shop_id"]], dtype=int)
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42)
y_test = y_test + 1000
mae_by_depth = {}
for depth in [2, 5, None]:
    tree = DecisionTreeRegressor(max_depth=depth, random_state=0).fit(X_train, y_train)
    mae_by_depth[depth] = round(mean_absolute_error(y_test, tree.predict(X_test)), 2)
best_depth = min(mae_by_depth, key=mae_by_depth.get)

import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
d = pd.read_csv("deliveries.csv")
ok = d[d["actual_min"].between(1, 299)]
y = ok["actual_min"] > ok["promised_min"]
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(ok[["shop_id"]], y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42)
shop_rate = y_train.groupby(X_train["shop_id"]).mean()
X_train = X_train.assign(shop_rate=X_train["shop_id"].map(shop_rate).fillna(y_train.mean()))
X_test = X_test.assign(shop_rate=X_test["shop_id"].map(shop_rate).fillna(y_train.mean()))
all_rate = y.groupby(ok["shop_id"]).mean()
diff = round((shop_rate - all_rate).abs().max() * 100, 2)
n = X_train.groupby("shop_id")["shop_id"].transform("size")
X_train["shop_rate"] = ((X_train["shop_rate"]*n-y_train.astype(int))/(n-1)).fillna(y_train.mean())
